description: This file defines logging-related classes, functions, and macros for the WPEFramework project. It includes class templates for logging categories, external function declarations for dumping exceptions and system files, and macros for logging control and message handling.

classes.name: BaseLoggingType
classes.description: A template class for logging categories, providing static methods to control and query logging status, and access metadata.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Triggers the announcement of the logging category, effectively calling IsEnabled().

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the logging category is enabled.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the logging category based on the boolean parameter.

methods.name: Metadata
methods.description: Returns the metadata associated with the logging category.
